title: Improve World — Shared Living Story World
vision: A shared high-detail 3D voxel-art world where players control an Eye, talk with Navigator, turn stories/intentions into playable changes, and co-create one persistent world.

entry: Open public link without mandatory email friction
Create anonymous guest identity and choose/detect interface language
See Navigator greeting and choose Create or Join
Create: express intent/story/image/idea; every question can be skipped
Join: select or receive a shared story/world thread

controls.principle: Eye/camera control must remain usable while Navigator chat stays visible and compact.

playerFantasy: I enter a living world that listens to my story, visibly changes because of what I say and do, remembers my contribution, and lets other people affect the same reality.
coreLoop: World Spec / Game Design Spec proposes a safe change
feedback + telemetry + Google runtime evidence improve the next cycle
outcome: A playable evolving story/world, not only text
A personal narrative path connected to the common world
A reusable World Spec/seed/replay that works in Web and Native

multiplayer.goal: Players inhabit the same authoritative world and can see, talk to, help, challenge and co-create with each other without language being a barrier.
interactions: translated text chat with original preserved
multiplayer.authority: Clients send intent/input; authoritative server validates and commits persistent gameplay state. Supabase Broadcast/Presence handles scalable transient collaboration; durable state lives in Postgres/RPC; fast PvP requires dedicated realtime server.

creativeEventLayers.question: What does the player physically do, and what rule changes?
What does the player see, and how is it detailed/readable?
What does the player hear, and how is repetition avoided?
What is risked and what is earned?
Is this teaching, escalation, climax, release, or turning point?
Why does this exist in the world and what does it reveal about the story/lore?

progression.principle: The world grows richer through conversation, exploration, collaboration and consequences rather than a detached menu-only progression.

quality.performance: maximize FPS per device without changing game rules

acceptance: all clients with same world id converge on authoritative state
at least two clients can occupy different positions and observe each other
Eye movement and look controls work on desktop/mobile
Navigator dialogue can create a visible governed world change
feedback becomes a guarded development candidate
new function reaches sandbox before Navigator
Google revision/runtime evidence is linked to the development loop
